title: Ticket form
purpose: See one ticket form with its fields and history, preview it as a client sees it, and add, reorder or open its fields.
summary: One ticket form: its category, portal settings, fields and change history. Add and reorder fields, preview the client's view, or edit the form. Only the admin role can open this page.

tasks.title: Add a field
steps: Select [[Add field]], name the field, choose its [[Type]] and [[Who fills it]], and save.
Select [[Move]] on a row, then [[Move up]] or [[Move down]], to put it where it belongs.

tasks.title: See the form as a client does
steps: Select [[Preview]]. The preview shows the fields a client fills and sends nothing.

tasks.title: Change or retire a field
steps: Select the field's name in the [[Fields]] table, make the change and give a reason.
To retire it, clear [[Active]]. Tickets that hold a value keep it.

tasks.title: Check why clients do not see the form
steps: Read the notice at the top and the portal line under the title: Offered in the portal, On the service menu or Staff only.
Select [[Edit form]] to change the portal settings.

good_to_know: A field is never deleted. Switch it off and it leaves the form, while tickets that hold a value keep it.
Once tickets hold values of a field, its type cannot change. Add a new field and switch the old one off.
Patient information fields are marked in the Rules column. Their values are revealed one at a time, with an audit entry, to staff who hold Can view patient information.
The history here lists changes to the form itself. Changes to a field are in that field's own history in the audit log.

items.label: Status line
items.description: Under the title: Active or Inactive, the category's name, the portal state (On the service menu, Offered in the portal or Staff only) and how many tickets were raised with the form.

items.label: Not offered
items.description: Shown for an active form whose category, or the category's group, is inactive. Neither clients nor staff can then use the form. Choose another category or reactivate the category.

items.label: Not in the portal
items.description: Shown when the form is marked for the portal but clients may not raise tickets in its category, so the portal does not offer it.

items.label: Copy form
items.description: Opens Copy, which creates a new form with every field of this one (inactive ones too, keys kept) under a new name and key. The copy is not on the service menu and has its own tickets and history. Use it for a variant, such as an urgent pickup beside the routine one.

items.label: Preview
items.description: Opens the preview page.

items.label: Edit form
items.description: Opens the form settings.

items.label: Add field
items.description: Shown only while the form is active. Opens the form to add a field.

items.label: Category
items.description: The category group and category tickets are filed under.

items.label: Client label
items.description: The name clients see: the client label, or the form name when there is none.

items.label: Menu description
items.description: The line under the label on the portal menu. None when empty.

items.label: Icon
items.description: The portal menu icon and its name.

items.label: Instructions
items.description: The text shown at the top of the form. None when empty.

items.label: Offered to
items.description: Every client organization, or the organizations the form is limited to. Set it with Edit form.

items.label: Key
items.description: The form's stable code. It never changes.

sections.title: Fields table
paragraphs: Fields are listed in the order the form shows them. The panel title counts the fields shown. Select Show inactive to include fields that were switched off, and Hide inactive to return. Inactive fields carry an Inactive mark and are not on the form.

items.label: Field
items.description: The field's label. It opens the field's settings.

items.label: Type
items.description: The kind of answer the field takes. Under it: the catalog name for an item list, or the number of options for a choice. An item list whose catalog is retired says so: it is left off new tickets until it uses an active catalog.

items.label: Who fills it
items.description: Client fills it; staff see it, Staff fill it; the client sees it, or Staff only.

items.label: Rules
items.description: Required or Optional, and a Patient information mark when the field holds patient information.

items.label: Values
items.description: How many values tickets hold for the field, counting corrected and replaced values too. Hidden first on narrow screens.

items.label: Move
items.description: Menu with Move up and Move down, one step each, recorded in the field's history. The first row has no Move up and the last no Move down. The move uses the full order, inactive fields included.

items.label: No fields yet
items.description: Shown when the form has no fields. Without fields the form asks only for the usual subject, description and reference.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: The latest recorded changes to the form itself, newest first, each with who made it, when and the reason. Reordering is recorded too. Changes to fields are not listed here.
